requiredFiles.description: App that fetches from a public API

criteria: The app fetches data from a real public API using async/await syntax — no raw .then() chains
Three distinct UI states are visible to the user: a loading state (shown while the request is in flight), a success state (data displayed), and an error state (shown when the request fails)
If the API request fails or the user is offline, the app falls back to showing cached data from localStorage — the fallback is visible and labeled as cached
Data is saved to localStorage on successful fetch and retrieved when the network is unavailable
No libraries are used for the fetch, state management, or rendering — vanilla JavaScript only
